inlines.v: EARNESTLY, adverb ern'estly. Warmly; zealously; importunately; eagerly; with real desire. Being in an agony, he prayed more earnestly Luke 22:44. That ye should earnestly contend for the faith once delivered to the saints. Jude 1:3. 2. With fixed attention; with eagerness. A certain maid looked earnestly upon him. Luke 22:44.
